text: Its other reactions, one line each. Reduction gives dichloromethane. Heating with silver powder strips all the chlorine and joins two carbons: ethyne. Nitric acid gives chloropicrin, a tear gas and soil fumigant. Propanone with dilute alkali gives chloretone, a sedative. Boiling alkali gives sodium methanoate. And with a primary amine and alcoholic potash, it gives an isocyanide with an appalling smell: the carbylamine test for primary amines.
